basis: Benign neoplasm arising in the larynx, which belongs to the airway axis.
Skeletal muscle chloride channelopathy causing myotonia, stiffness and weakness; no primary nerve disease.
Hereditary chorea with motor delay; thyroid and pulmonary disease are not established for this specific phenotype.
ACTH-secreting pituitary adenoma; visual loss and field defects occur in 30-79%. Hyperpigmentation does not establish skin damage; Cushing features are not intrinsic Nelson disease.
Definition specifies an actual skin basal cell carcinoma caused by TP53 mutation, despite the susceptibility wording.
Hair shaft variant producing apparent alternating bands; confined to the dermatologic axis.
Classical complement immunodeficiency. Discoid lupus and bacterial meningitis are separately diagnosed associated diseases, rather than direct organ damage from complement deficiency.
Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder defined by ataxia and peripheral neuropathy; ophthalmoparesis can reflect neurologic dysfunction.
Cortical malformations, intellectual disability, seizures and peripheral neuropathy are neurologic; no established common damage to another axis.
Traction osteochondrosis of the tibial tubercle growth plate; local inflammation does not establish an immune-mediated disease.
Congenital eyelid tarsal malformation causing entropion and potentially corneal ulceration; all within the ocular axis.
Malignant mesenchymal smooth muscle soft tissue tumor; no specific visceral origin is supplied. Vascular invasion does not define a separate vascular disease.
Fanconi anemia; anal atresia in 2/2, severe renal failure in 1/1 with urinary anomalies in 1/3, and thumb/radial malformations in 1/3 support additional axes.
Neurodevelopmental delay and cardiac malformations are defining features. Frequencies of ocular and skeletal abnormalities are insufficiently established across this variable syndrome.
GRIN2D encephalopathy causes seizures and developmental impairment. Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic; flat feet alone do not establish substantive skeletal damage.
Myofibroblastic soft tissue sarcoma; no specific organ of origin is supplied. Inflammatory histology does not make this an immune-mediated disease.
Platelet granule dysfunction causes impaired haemostasis; bleeding sites do not establish independent organ damage.
Isolated high myopia with globe elongation and reduced visual acuity; SCO2 alone does not establish systemic mitochondrial disease.
Malignant neoplasm of the central nervous system; lymphoma is only one subtype and does not justify an immune axis for the umbrella.
Benign fibrosing breast lesions lie outside the axes. Associated diabetes is a separate disease; an autoimmune mechanism is not established by the supplied definition.
Pancytopenia, immunodeficiency and cutaneous malignancies define the syndrome. Pulmonary damage is not established as common; infections alone do not establish it.
Disease of the nose, included in the airway axis; smell dysfunction is only one subtype and does not justify neurologic labeling of the umbrella.
Bilateral congenital fusion of the humerus and radius is a structural bone and joint disorder.
Inherited vitreoretinal degeneration with cataract, chorioretinal atrophy and retinal detachment; confined to the ocular axis.
Congenital TSH deficiency; neurodevelopmental delay and abnormal epiphyses/delayed skeletal maturation occur in 30-79%. Dry skin and constipation alone do not establish organ damage.
